### GET `/api/PostalServices/GetPostalServices`

Gets a list of the users postal services and information on channels and couriers linked to each service Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.ShippingService.PostalServicesNode

### POST `/api/PostalServices/CreatePostalService`

Adds a new postal service to the database Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.ShippingService.PostalServicesNode

### POST `/api/PostalServices/UpdatePostalService`

Changes an existing postal service in the database Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.ShippingService.PostalServicesNode

### POST `/api/PostalServices/DeletePostalService`

Changes an existing postal service in the database Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.ShippingService.PostalServicesNode

### GET `/api/PostalServices/GetChannelLinks`

Returns Channel Service Link Information Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.ShippingService.PostalServicesNode

| Param | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `postalServiceId` | query | `string` | False | Postal service ID |
